rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: WhatsApp MCP Server connects AI agents to personal WhatsApp accounts using TypeScript and the Baileys library. It stores messages and authentication locally in SQLite and provides tools for searching contacts, retrieving message history, listing chats, and sending messages. The implementation includes QR code authentication, real-time event handling, and comprehensive privacy controls, making it ideal for users who want their AI assistants to interact with WhatsApp conversations without compromising data security.
